eu-32006r1907.title: Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 — REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals)
eu-32006r1907.summary: Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 of 18 December 2006 establishes the EU framework for the registration, evaluation, authorisation and restriction of chemical substances (REACH) and created the European Chemicals Agency. For vehicle makers and suppliers it drives material compliance, including substances of very high concern (Annex XIV authorisation list) and restricted substances (Annex XVII).
eu-32006r1907._why: Findings: title is bare CELEX number, summary describes a scrape failure, date matches no REACH milestone; REACH entered into force 1 Jun 2007 (adopted 18 Dec 2006).

eu-32017r1151.title: Commission Regulation (EU) 2017/1151 — Light-Duty Vehicle Emissions Type-Approval (Euro 5/6, WLTP, RDE)
eu-32017r1151.summary: Commission Regulation (EU) 2017/1151 of 1 June 2017 supplements Regulation (EC) No 715/2007 on type-approval of motor vehicles with respect to emissions from light passenger and commercial vehicles (Euro 5 and Euro 6). It sets the WLTP and real-driving-emissions test procedures, CO2 and fuel consumption measurement, on-board diagnostics and evaporative emission requirements, and replaced Regulation (EC) No 692/2008.
